Plan the week in one page

Updated weekly by the team

A short guide to setting out the week so that each day has one clear job. It keeps the list short, puts the hard task first, and leaves a little room at the end of each day for whatever turned up. Most people find it easier to start than a long list, because the first step is always obvious.

Write the three things that matter, then block the time for them before anything else goes in. When something new arrives, ask which of the three it replaces. If the answer is none, it waits until next week, and that is fine.

What goes on the page

One line per day, one job per line, and a short note on what done looks like. Keep it where you will see it every morning, and cross things out by hand at the end of the day.

Monday: the hard task
Wednesday: the review
Friday: the tidy-up
